verdict.rationale: Puzzle is SaaS accounting software, and self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or downloadable deployment of the core product. Every documented surface (app, REST API, MCP endpoint, sandbox) is vendor-hosted, and data export does not count as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
